title: Fenris
summary: Fenris is a powerful wolf-like Titan, the only known specimen of which once roamed through the caves under the Temple of Thor. This wild and animalistic Titan was later used by Montehue, becoming among his choice Titans in the fight against evil Seeker groups. Many Seekers think Fenris and Wolf Knight were behind the legends of werewolves.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Fenris was once the Titan of Thor himself and was left to guard the restricted caves beneath the Temple of Thor long after his Seeker's death. With the magic of Thor's temple keeping Fenris invoked through the centuries, he remained active and rabid for thousands of years into the modern age. [Two Powers Become One]

While both the Huntik Foundation and the Organization were trying to find Mjolnir, the Hammer of Thor, the wild Titan, Fenris, was also discovered past the Door of Infinity. Virtually invulnerable to attacks due to the magic of the temple, Fenris attempted to attack Dante Vale's team, but he eventually tied up with the Rope of Gleipnir using some help from Springer. As the magical rope could not be broken, Fenris was constricted and eventually send back to his Amulet. Dante picked up the Amulet and gave it to Montehue after the mission, believing Fenris would bond readily to a Seeker with a character close to that of Thor. [Two Powers Become One]

During the mission to acquire the Ring of Tao, Montehue summoned Fenris to fight the three colossi outside King Solomon's mines. Fenris teamed up with Lok's Lindorm to defeat Ashtoreth. Later, in the mines, Fenris battled against Dominator. When Dominator's spikes became lodged in Fenris, his ability caused Fenris to temporarily revert to his berserk state and refuse to listen to Montehue. [To Be Together]

Fenris was later used by Montehue in Indonesia to fight against a Silent Soldier's Shadow Kuolit. Fenris proved to be faster than the Shadow Kuolit, who attempted to slice him, but the shadows from Shadow Kuolit's body injured the wolf Titan. [The Dead Magic Island] The following day, Fenris helped Montehue fight numerous Blood Spiral forces and later witnessed Sophie Casterwill rising from the lava of a volcano with Phoenix, the Legendary Titan of Rebirth. [The Phoenix's Ashes]

Fenris fought in the battle at the Blood Spiral Base. He saved Scarlet Byrne from a Nighlurker Titan before being floored himself by a Marauder. He was then saved when the Marauder was picked up and defeated by Scarlet's Firbolg Titan. [Lok and the Betrayer]

sections.heading: Abilities
sections.wikitext: Unlike other Titans, Fenris was able to draw his power from the walls of Thor's Temple in order to remain active and rabid, for centuries. The [[Guardians of Thor]] feared Fenris' immense strength, speed, and wild nature. His senses are as keen as those of a wolf. His claws are razor sharp, and his jaws are strong enough to crush bones and masticate flesh. All of this, combined with his ferocious predatory nature, makes him a very dangerous Titan to encounter, as he will attack anything, with an unprovoked viciousness similar to a rabid animal.
